key_idea: Check the cubes one by one and count the cubes each one touches face to face.
steps: There is a row of 3 cubes. The cube at the end of the row has 1 cube on top of it and 1 cube in front of it.
The end cube touches the middle cube of the row, the cube on top and the cube in front. That is 3.
The middle cube of the row touches only 2 cubes. Each of the other 3 cubes touches only 1.
So just 1 cube touches exactly 3 others.

choice_feedback.B: Only the end cube touches 3 others. The middle cube of the row touches just 2.
choice_feedback.C: Most cubes touch only 1 other cube. Only the end cube touches 3.
choice_feedback.D: Most cubes touch only 1 other cube. Only the end cube touches 3.
choice_feedback.E: Most cubes touch only 1 other cube. Only the end cube touches 3.
